name: heylook-provider
description: Wire an application to heylook (heylookitsanllm) as a local inference provider: /v1/messages wire, runtime capability discovery via probe.py, opt-in x-api-key/Bearer access gate & always-on Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site guards, system prompts vs presets vs sampler cascade, multi-turn prompt caching, /v1/embeddings, client-side image resize, and porting off the removed OpenAI route.
suggestedPrompts: Probe my local heylook server at http://localhost:8000 and wire it into this app as an inference provider
Add heylook alongside our existing Gemini provider using runtime model discovery and capability gating
Port this client off heylook's removed /v1/chat/completions route to /v1/messages with client-side image resize
